title: A filtered-out posting names the gate and what it would score, and stops rescanning
deviations_from_card: Per the critic revision, docs/features/matching/README.md was NOT touched (recruiter path byte-identical); docs/features/jobseeker/README.md carries the change. Added app/_lib/jobseeker/match.test.ts (colocated test for match.ts) and cases in app/_lib/db/jobseeker-postings.test.ts (colocated test of a write-set module) - tests only. Commits are feature-layered (catalogs / engine+py test / doc / TS+TS tests) rather than test-then-feat, so every commit is green; the catalogs and doc were committed alone under the lock. Extra catalog keys beyond the card: me.posting.match.blockedAsIf and blockedLink (all 4 locales); me.posting.match.notScored copy rewritten in 4 locales to name only the not-yet-matched state. Gate chips in PostingRow render one caution Badge per ko key (not CHIP_QUIET) so the filtered state reads as a mismatch.
notes: Red-before: Python 5 of 6 (the byte-identical no-flag CLI guard passes before and after, by design); TS 11 of 11 (matchChunk 3, scan (g) 1, store 2 and view 3 - the store/view files failed to import before). tsc: only foreign errors (app/_lib/stage-hooks.ts:307 from a sibling, and the untracked kpi-sim/ tree), none in my files. test:unit: the only failure is the known environmental FLAKE app/_lib/python-runner-concurrency.test.ts process-tree case. test:perf on the LIVE tree is red by 2-5 KB on ~22 task-hub api routes, but that is siblings' UNCOMMITTED files: measured via git archive HEAD + my files alone, app/api/devcase/control/route.ts is 3111 KB (ceiling 3126) and evaluate() reports 0 findings; my only graph addition is ~0.7 KB in app/_lib/jobseeker/types.ts (KO_REASON_KEYS + isKoReasonKey), so no ceiling was raised. KP_JOBSEEKER_SCAN_SPAWN=1 run of scan.test.ts (real match_cli spawns with --include-blocked) is green. review:constitution per own commit: no finding (the full-range run flags app/api/voice/readiness/route.ts route-auth-posture and a rate-limit-contract gate-configuration note - both sibling commits 0a188f318/b85906d1d, not this card). MATCH_VERSION bumped to jobseeker-match-v2: every stored seeker row is re-matched once on the next scan. Read->write: setPostingBlocked re-checks (UPDATE ... AND job_json IS NOT NULL, changes===0 skip), no transaction, no await. loop_open: app/_lib/jobseeker-fit-context.ts passes the stored match_json verbatim, so for a filtered posting the fit coach (pipeline/jobfit/jobseeker.py fit_gaps/fit_questions) receives {blocked, asIf} and reads no eligibility/missingSkills - the same empty context as before this card, not a regression, but passing asIf plus the gate would let the coach cite the blocking gate; outside the write set, recorded as a Known gap in docs/features/jobseeker/README.md. Also unchanged by design: deepdive.ts re-match ignores the blocked tail (keeps the earlier score, as the card states); ScanSummary still has no filtered count (the log line ko_filtered stays).
